title: Actual pro-etale open extension has a slice presentation
statement: For any open immersion j:U→V of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], arbitrary ring sheaves RV on V and RU on U, and an isomorphism j⁻¹RV≅RU [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], there is an equivalence e from RU-module sheaves on U to RV-module sheaves on the slice at the open object j, and the actual left adjoint proEtaleRingOpenExtension j RV RU c is naturally isomorphic to e followed by the literal direct-sum-and-sheafification slice extension [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. No quasi-compactness is required.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 03DJ, extension to the open slice; Sites Tags 09BN and 00XZ, localization of the site.

proof.text: Use proEtale_ringed_open_comparison to identify actual inverse-image modules with modules on the ambient slice. Scalar restriction along the specified coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence from RU modules to inverse-image-ring modules. Compose these equivalences. Transport the slice extension adjunction through the ringed-open comparison, then through the coefficient equivalence. Its right adjoint is exactly the actual proEtaleRingModulePullback. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the resulting composite with actual open extension.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleOpen_slicePresentation {U V : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (RV : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RU : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage j CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RV ≅ RU) :
    ∃ e : proEtaleRingModules U RU ≌
        SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology V)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RV).over (ProEt.mk j)),
      Nonempty (proEtaleRingOpenExtension j RV RU c ≅ e.functor ⋙
        SheafOfModules.localizedModuleExtension.{u} RV (ProEt.mk j))
